content: {"episode_id":"ep-05117","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) for this patient, who presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). As documented in the clinical indication note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. The submitted records support the medical necessity of this monitoring, and we request reconsideration of the determination."}
